meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会运行 scripts/generate_image.py 脚本,调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型(如 Gemini、FLUX.2)生成或编辑图片,并把结果保存为本地 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你要生成照片、插画、概念图等非技术类图片,或要基于已有图片做修改时触发。流程图、电路图等技术示意图请改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 帮我生成一张山间日落的图片
say.note: 会在当前目录存为 generated_image.png

say.text: 把 photo.jpg 里的天空改成紫色
say.note: 以该图为输入,进入编辑模式

say.text: 用 flux.2-pro 模型生成一张抽象画
say.note: 指定要使用的 OpenRouter 模型

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs the generate_image.py script to create or edit images with OpenRouter models (such as Gemini, FLUX.2), saving the result as a PNG file locally.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want photos, illustrations or concept art, or edits based on an existing image. For flowcharts and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a sunset over mountains
say_en.note: Saved as generated_image.png in the current directory

say_en.text: Make the sky in photo.jpg purple
say_en.note: Uses that image as input and switches to edit mode

say_en.text: Generate abstract art with the flux.2-pro model
say_en.note: Picks the OpenRouter model to use
